coordinate_and_domain_contract: Omega/P/B as spatial audit. Pixel centers p=(i+0.5,j+0.5) in full-canvas pixels; R in float64 [0,1] encoded RGB mean absolute difference. B is the frozen raster ROI, not a newly thresholded mask. Requested c*, w*, h* are continuous original bbox geometry.

metrics.interpretation: all edit energy; not defect visibility or quality
metrics.size_caveat: not directly comparable across canvas/bbox size; report area and separate per-pixel energy diagnostics without changing the base definition

metrics.domain_equivalence: by paste, numerator equals sum_{p in P minus B}R(p)
metrics.interpretation: fraction of edit energy outside requested raster ROI; can be small when bad in-box changes are very large
metrics.related_hard_metric: drift on Omega minus P is MECHANICALLY_DETERMINED, ineligible

metrics.redundant_with: ECR=1-BDR when E_total>0; cannot count as independent primary endpoints

metrics.interpretation: global edit-energy center relative to requested center, not defect center
metrics.confound: P minus B resynthesis can dominate; do not call this defect location accuracy

metrics.formula: E_B=sum_{p in B}R(p); mu_B=sum_{p in B}p*R(p)/E_B; Sigma_RB=sum_{p in B}R(p)*(p-mu_B)*(p-mu_B)^T/E_B; rms_width=sqrt(Sigma_RB_xx); rms_height=sqrt(Sigma_RB_yy); extent_ratio_x=rms_width/w*; extent_ratio_y=rms_height/h*
metrics.anisotropy: (lambda_max-lambda_min)/(lambda_max+lambda_min) for Sigma_RB; if trace=0, null with UNDEFINED_ZERO_SPATIAL_SPREAD
metrics.convention: RMS means one spatial standard deviation, NOT a full bounding span, no factor 2 or sqrt(12). Ratio 1 is not an expected target. Pixel-center discrete covariance is used, no subpixel mask inferred.
metrics.interpretation: spatial spread of actual changes WITHIN the raster bbox; truncated by ROI; NOT defect size or segmentation
metrics.denominator_zero: if E_B=0 all conditional moments null, UNDEFINED_ZERO_IN_BOX_EDIT_ENERGY
metrics.secondary_diagnostic: mu_B and its requested-center displacement may be reported under an explicit IN_BOX_CENTROID name; never substitute silently for global NCE

metrics.formula: K(I,B)=sqrt((1/(3*|B|))*sum_{c,p in B}(I(p,c)-mean_{q in B}I(q,c))^2); LOCAL_EDIT_CONTRAST=K(G,B)-K(N,B)
metrics.interpretation: change in channelwise local intensity spread only, not DEFECT_QUALITY; both positive and negative values allowed

metrics.candidate: means of R over a fixed inner ring and fixed outer ring about the frozen bbox, and their signed/absolute difference
definition_requirements: freeze ring construction and width from resolution/bbox geometry independent of outputs and AP
freeze corner/side weighting and area normalization
ensure both rings lie in P; otherwise explicitly declare unavailable, never move the ROI or drop the slot
retain original size units and bbox-normalized geometry; width must not erase small-box interiors
metrics.patch_boundary_caveat: P-edge is a hard paste seam and a different estimand; do not mix it into bbox boundary blending
metrics.interpretation: residual seam proxy, not visual blend validity

metrics.formula: for one frozen slot and one predefined M: median(M_1..M_k); IQR=Q_0.75-Q_0.25; range=max-min; sample_SD=sqrt(sum(M_i-mean(M))^2/(k-1))
metrics.quantile_rule: linear interpolation, h=(k-1)*q, interpolate neighboring order statistics (type 7)
metrics.sample_size_rule: k>=2 for SD; report k and finite/undefined counts separately. No imputing zero, no quality omission.
metrics.pairing: only sample RNG changes; normal/bbox/prompt/checkpoint/scheduler/crop/runtime fixed. Slot is repeated-measures unit, not independent pair count.
metrics.success_claim: low variability alone is not improvement; separately report full adherence values, E_total and appearance diversity, no combined score

metrics.candidate: all unordered RNG-output pairs for the same slot; bbox-only ROI perceptual distance; prefer spatial LPIPS with explicitly restricted inputs/ROI averaging
metrics.interpretation: appearance variation, not defect validity or quality

forbidden_metrics: copied-label position/size agreement as image adherence
teacher bbox as true generated geometry
zero-energy residual classified as accurate placement
